name: Grandpa and Me vs the Numbers
summary: The numbers have gone bad, and Grandpa needs you to help stop them. Jump into this small, side-scrolling shooter with platformer elements. Travel through different levels, destroy numbers as you go, and defeat enemy bosses. Use blocks to get to tricky places or for tactical advantage. Play single player or with up to three friends in local couch co-op mode. Destroy bad numbers, defeat enemy bosses, use blocks, and save the world.
